consequence.statement: The Cilium Operator's Kubernetes client now uses a default rate limit of 100 QPS/200 Burst, which may differ from previous agent-level defaults; operators can now independently configure these rates using the new --operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst flags.

assertion.statement: The Cilium Operator component introduces two new CLI flags (--operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst) to allow separate configuration of Kubernetes client rate limits, with a new default of 100 QPS/200 Burst.
